items.title: Additional feature?
items.text: Hi developers! WhatsApp is super useful, it’s my go-to messaging platform. I use it almost daily, and have rarely ever had problems with it. Clean, simple, easy to use, aesthetically pleasing interface, WhatsApp is great in a lot of ways. One of my issues with WhatsApp, however great it may be, is that the features regarding image sending and editing is extremely simple. I understand that you don’t want to make it too complicated, it is a messaging platform and not an art platform after all. However, I’ve noticed that when trying to mark up images and draw on them I’ll often have a particular colour that I used that I want to reuse, but there is no tool to grab a colour and use it again, and this has been quite frustrating. I’m not saying that you should incorporate extravagant colour pickers or a way to save old colours, that’s unnecessary. I just think it would be extremely beneficial to include a button (perhaps an eye dropper) below the colours that you can use to pick colours from an image or previous lines to match. I’d really appreciate your consideration, as I think it would be very useful. :)Thanks

items.title: WhatsApp. Hmmm get it or don’t get it?
items.text: Hi I’m back. With another app review. This app is something that I personally use to connect with all of my friends and family. 💕WhatsApp💕:⭐️WhatsApp is a great place for connecting with other people that are distant to you and people who you are not currently spending time with. ⭐️The status portion on the app creates a way to share what you are doing to all of your contacts. My only critique for this portion of the app is that I wish it had more, funny filters, pretty filters, music overlays, so that it would better compare against other apps that people would be using instead of WhatsApp (such as Instagram, TikTok or Snapchat).⭐️The calls on WhatsApp are good and have reliable connectivity. ⭐️ For the camera portion of the app, again, I wish that the camera had funny filters, pretty filters and music overlays. This would make it so much better for me. ⭐️The messages portion of the app is pretty good. I like that you can delete messages on your end and the other person’s end before they’ve seen it. I like that you can see if the massage has delivered and been read. I LOVE the fact that you can change your chat backgrounds. You can have group chats on WhatsApp too. This is a great option for people in sporting teams, family members, people working on a school or work projects together or some friends who want to talk. ❓So back to our question earlier:❓ WhatsApp. To get it or not to get it? I think that’s totally up to you but I personally think that this app is very good. The only thing that I really think needs improving is the  status portion of the app. I really hope the status portion of the app gets an upgrade because it’s laCkYinGAnyway that’s all from me today. I’ll have another review tomorrow.

items.title: Add photo info!
items.text: Hi WhatsApp,This app is really great, I use it everyday and is exactly what I need! It is a basic app for messaging, but with so many advanced features! However, I think a really good improvement for this app would be to have information on photos you send. So if you click on your photo either on a chat or status, you can find out who saved or took a screenshot of it. This would be very beneficial for many users, and enhance the app even more! One more thing that would be great to be able to do is delete photos, even if everyone has viewed it. Every person I’ve talked to wants this feature, and it would be helpful for personal, non business related chats. So once everyone has viewed it, you could still go back and delete it before more people save it. I would love to see these as an addition for WhatsApp, as it is such a great app! Thanks for your time!

items.title: —USER BEWARE— WhatsApp deletes reported messages
items.text: I have received a message on whatapp that is part of an ongoing harassment. In a separate incident, I also received messages that were sexual harassment (a man I didn’t know asking me for photos of my naked body). Both times I reported it to WhatsApp straight away. The first time it happened I then tried to reported it to the group the man tried to get my number from to get him removed from the group. The group asked for evidence, and I couldn’t find the messages. The second time it happened, I needed to take a screen shot to get the person prosecuted with local authorities. And I couldn’t find the message. I have since realised whatsapp must delete messages if you report the person. The moral of the story? Don’t report to WhatsApp because nothing happens from their end and you’ll lose the messages.I’m guessing that WhatsApp will say they do it for your safety, but the truth is they don’t want people to have screen shots of bad messages sent on their platform. It doesn’t make me safer not being able to report the messages to the group or to the police. I contacted WhatsApp with a polite message requesting access to the message I received so I could report it to local authorities. The WhatsApp support was so unhelpful I was flabbergasted. I think this is a really dangerous feature and users should be made very aware of it in case it happens to them. It’s happened to me twice now and I’m just a normal nice person, so I think it’s a pretty common occurrence.

items.title: Switching between phones!
items.text: Hi!Undoubtedly this app is something part of our daily life now and after all these years of technological advancement - it’s a shame that transferring from an old iPhone to new one could so painful !! Whatever the app suggests doesn’t match the reality at all and it’s a very very annoying feel given other popular app like such of WeChat was so quick and easy between the phones to transfer ! I did back up on iCloud and some messages / group chats are missing when transferred but then i had to fall back to old phone - reinstall and get on with usual business chats.I request the concern people to address this issue urgently & see how to make UX of this particular feature more reliable and practical .  Thank you and best of luck !

items.title: Wow so private!
items.text: If there was ever an equivalent of social services that took words away while they were being abused then WhatsApp would have the word ‘private’ in front of a child psychologist showing the nice lady where exactly on the toy smartphone it was that weird Uncle WhatsApp took photos of them without their knowledge and sold the offer to data to his all of sweaty golfing buddies. That’s before the child psychologist smashes the toy on the ground and forgets about the whole 'tortured simile' thing, and having a sticky beak by scrolling down there ⤹ ~<(* )  and looking at all the information WhatsApp thinks it deserves - like a couch surfing room mate asking clarifiers during a family emergency.  Here's a better idea: Don't download it! Because the fact you need to scroll down at all to check what data an app employing the word  ‘private’ (in its product heading no less) is demanding is like - shoving a mango scented marker pen up your nostril and then checking the back of the box to determine how many servings of your daily recommended fruit intake it just counted as.

items.title: What’s app review from Renjith Rajagopalan
items.text: What’s app from its invention in 2009 has become one of the most frequently used applications in smart phones. It provides the range for regular chatting, voice calling and live video calling domestically and around the world in every nation internationally.The service has maximized communication between human souls in an efficient and elegant manner. People have saved on millions of dollars in landline and mobile phone bills through this system. The techniques are grasped well by people of all age groups. And the following of global celebrities and various industries and associations is made easier through various groups within what’s app. The revival of the golden era music alongside educational reminders happens in brilliant videos over what’s app.

items.title: WhatsApp is nice but there’s a few features missing
items.text: Hi don’t get me wrong I love WhatsApp it’s so easy and convenient to use. But there’s are some things that could be better. One thing that come to mind for me is that you could add a share all chat history option onto group chats. For example the other day, I wanted to add a new member to my friendship group chat, sharing all the chat history so that the new member would always know what was going on. But when I tried to do that, I just added the member in. No chat history shared. I tried changing this in settings, asked meta ai for help, but nothing proved useful. I even removed the new member from the group chat multiple times, trying to find out how to share the chat history. I couldn’t and this is the one thing that really makes WhatsApp not good for me. Another bummer for me is meta ai. It’s not quite as accurate or easy to understand with its instructions as I would like it to be, but that’s not too big of an issue, so I understand if fixing this is not an option at the momentOtherwise I love it so much it’s an amazing app and doesn’t use much data to use, so you can use it anywhere, even if you have weak signal. Good job Meta group, and keep it up!!! ☺️☺️
